title: Affirmation is its own layer; in chat it is a fake decision (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Ok, let's be careful of the affirmation steps for stories. They are one of the core problems for breaking our work.

When we are defining work, we don't stop and jump to affirmation. That is a whole separate layer. We need a special interface for affirmations. Affirmation in a chat session is abstract because I cannot see the structure clearly enough to actually affirm, and this just becomes another fake decision... I have to say yes because I assume it's right... The very thing that was supposed to be the sovereign anchor becomes exactly the thing that undermines it. 

The narrative based affirmation editor is the current attempt at a remedy that presents the derived records in context, it must show the flow of conversation that originated the ideas. 


Vignettes need to be collated in multiple ways. A set of vignettes that come from the same conversation should be visible together , but we should also be able to find horizontal connections to the same topic across sessions. 

We will end up clustering stories and problems and remedies. Building our understanding in stages through experience and pain
